rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for giving items or shares out to people.

example.english: We dispense lucky money to staff every New Year.
example.traditional: 我哋每年新年都派利是畀員工。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 mui5 nin4 san1 nin4 dou1 paai3 lei6 si6 bei2 jyun4 gung1

rows.note: Use this specifically when a pharmacist supplies or prepares prescribed medicine.

example.english: This pharmacy will dispense medicine according to the doctor's prescription.
example.traditional: 呢間藥房會按醫生張處方配藥。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 joek6 fong4 wui5 on3 ji1 sang1 zoeng1 cyu2 fong1 pui3 joek6

rows.note: Use this in formal or administrative contexts when someone is exempted from a requirement.

example.english: The school can dispense with requiring him to submit the document this time.
example.traditional: 校方今次豁免佢提交文件。
example.jyutping: haau6 fong1 gam1 ci3 kut3 min5 keoi5 tai4 gaau1 man4 gin6
